decisions.reason: It is closely aligned with the firm's core dental-practice software and the shift toward digital, connected workflows, so management would likely retain it even if it was later absorbed into the broader product suite.
Training and practitioner support are already part of the firm's key resources, so a continuing-education offer strengthens customer loyalty and complements the software business.
A remote screen-sharing support tool directly improves service delivery for existing software customers and fits the firm's support-heavy business model.
Practice performance analytics closely supports the firm's promise of more efficient practice management and is a natural extension of its established software platform.
A complete practice bundle is highly consistent with the firm's broad product portfolio and its focus on serving practices of different sizes with integrated solutions.

A job and practice listing portal is comparatively distant from the firm's core software and support activities, and with only limited website prominence it is the weakest strategic fit for continued investment.
